guarantees: Every result identifies the exact projection version, Brain snapshot and engine version.
Every output has a machine-readable outputTrace linking it to facts, rules, dependencies, constants, overrides or pure operations.
Unresolved states never masquerade as resolved conclusions.
Output fingerprints are stable for semantically identical executions.
Warnings and limitations are preserved for consumers.
consumerRules: Consumers must branch on status before reading outputs.
Consumers must not infer values from missing outputs.
Consumers must display or preserve human-review and limitation signals.
Consumers must not alter legal-basis trace.
Consumers may format human-readable text but must not rewrite the canonical result.
privacyRules: Result payloads should reference fact identifiers rather than duplicate personal evidence.
Sensitive evidence contents remain outside canonical result objects.
Logs must support redaction without breaking fingerprints of canonical legal outputs.
